games.title: Kakanin Crush
games.description: Swap puto, kutsinta, sapin-sapin, bibingka, ube halaya and suman on Lola Pacing's bilao at a fiesta stall. Make a Sandok, a Kaldero, a Bilao ng Lahat, clean the latik, and sell out with an Ubos-Benta.

games.title: Bakbakan sa Kanto
games.tagline: The street fighting classic, Pinoy style
games.description: Pick Lakan the arnisador, Dalisay the sikaran kicker, Mang Tanod, or Boy Balut and his basket of lobbed balut, and fight your way across Cubao, a barangay court and Divisoria to the balete tree, where the Kapre waits. It has combos, specials, supers and throws, three CPU levels, a training mode, and two-player versus.

games.title: Tumbang Preso
games.description: Throw your tsinelas at the sardinas can, then run to get it back before the taya tags you. Play against Buboy, Nene, Kulot and Bong on a 3D street at dusk, with the sari-sari store, the jeepney and the banderitas. Plug in a PlayStation controller, or use the keyboard or touch.

games.title: Hollow Blocks
games.description: Stack kawayan, hollow blocks, ladrilyo, yero, plywood, baldosa and adobe on a construction site. Clear four rows at once for a BAYANIHAN, raise the building floor by floor, beat the Deadline, or hold off the Bagyo flood.

games.title: Tawid EDSA
games.tagline: The classic lane-crossing game, Pinoy style
games.description: Get Kokak the palaka across rainy EDSA traffic, then ride the troso and the pagong over the estero, the baha and the Pasig to his family's five gabi leaves. Dodge the buwaya, eat the lamok, and bring the lost anak home.

games.title: Bagong Taon
games.tagline: The classic maze-bomber, New Year's Eve style
games.description: Chase the malas out of every kanto with cartoon Bawang before midnight. Shoo them into kwitis, fill Lola's media noche table, beat the old wall calendar, and jump at 12:00. Two players can share one keyboard.

games.title: Habulan sa Palengke
games.tagline: The classic maze chase, Pinoy style
games.description: Eat all the pan de sal while four tsismosa titas chase you through the palengke, simbahan and mall. Grab Nanay's tsinelas and chase them back.

games.title: Bantay Kubo
games.description: Drive a jeepney tank, fire garlic, and guard the bahay kubo from duwende, tikbalang, aswang, kapre and manananggal across ten barangays, with a Kapreng Balete and a Bakunawa to beat.

games.title: Ahas sa Fiesta
games.tagline: Classic snake at a Pinoy fiesta
games.description: A flag-colored snake in a salakot eats street food on a woven banig and dodges the tinikling poles, through seven festival barangays.

games.title: Huling Byahe
games.tagline: The last jeepney of the night
games.description: Drive the last trip through Manila from 11 PM to 5 AM. Your passengers are ghosts, and each one has somewhere to be before sunrise.

games.title: Isang Tira
games.description: Play Sungka against Lola Iska, the traditional way: turns, relays, captures, and round after round with burnt houses. Three levels of Lola, plus a daily one-turn puzzle.

games.title: Lipat-Bahay
games.tagline: A family moves house, one push at a time
games.description: A 3D pushing puzzle with a story: Tatay pushes the heavy things, Ate the boxes, little Migo squeezes through gaps, and lined up together they move anything. 36 rooms from the province to Manila and home for Christmas, an endless Moving Day with surprises, a daily room, and a room editor to share.
